literal_meaning: ছিন্নভিন্ন ও কুটকুটে (torn and chopped into pieces)
figurative_meaning_en: Having a haphazard or disorganized nature
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এক ছরকুটে লোক, কোনো কাজই ঠিকমতো করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a haphazard person who never does anything properly.
The state of the room has become disorganized.
note: Refers to a lack of order in appearance or behavior, common in spoken Bengali.
